subject: Allocation discrepancy: EMEA reseller remittance mis-tagged (VAT codes)
messages:
From: Marcus Holt <mholt@octagon-resellers.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: payments@octagon-resellers.com
Date: 2028-03-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Payment posted to wrong invoice / VAT code mismatch

Hi Soojin,

Our treasury ran the Feb 28 remittance and it looks like one of the payments (EUR 46,200) was applied to an older invoice (INV-2027-1184) instead of the March invoice (INV-2028-031). That old invoice already had a VAT reversal code applied; as a result the net and VAT recorded in our GL don’t line up with your remittance file.

Can you confirm whether Redwood reallocated payments on your side, or if we should raise a suspense journal? We are getting pushed by our tax team to correct the VAT tagging before month close.

Attached is our remittance extract (remittance_20280228.csv).

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Holt
AR Manager — Octagon Resellers
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: Marcus Holt <mholt@octagon-resellers.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice / VAT code mismatch

Hi Marcus — thanks for the note and the CSV. I pulled your file into our remittance flow and I can see the EUR 46,200 payment was matched to INV-2027-1184 by our auto-matcher yesterday evening.

Before we book any reversing entries, two quick asks so we can preserve revenue mapping and avoid double-counting VAT:
- Can you confirm the payer reference on the wire (our remittance only shows "OCT-0274" — we want to cross-check with your inbound reference)
- Do you have any internal credit or intercompany memo that would justify the older allocation?

I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik from Finance; Marissa — can you advise whether we should push an AR reallocation (move cash from the old invoice to INV-2028-031) or post a suspense credit then run a journal correction tied to the VAT ledger?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice / VAT code mismatch

Quick summary from my side:
- Auto-matcher allocated per bank reference; the cash is physically applied to INV-2027-1184 in AR.
- That invoice had a manual VAT reversal last year (tax code ZR) which is why your GL shows a mismatch.

Recommendation: reallocate the cash to INV-2028-031 and post a balancing journal to correct the VAT ledger (so we preserve recognized revenue for the correct period). I'll need a copy of the remittance + our invoice PDF to attach to the journal ticket.

If we do a suspense credit instead we'll have to reconcile twice (suspense -> correct invoice -> reverse previous reversal), which adds risk for MTD VAT reporting.

Karthik — can you confirm the revenue recognition mapping for INV-2028-031 if we move the receipt? I want to ensure no revenue is picked up in the wrong month after we touch the cash application.

— Marissa
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice / VAT code mismatch

Marissa / Soojin — checked INV-2028-031 (subscription renewal; recognized monthly over 12 months starting 2028-03-01). If we reallocate the receipt to INV-2028-031 today:
- Cash application will clear AR for the current invoice; revenue deferral schedule stays the same (no change to amortization start date).
- VAT booking must reflect the standard VAT code (S1-EU) for the invoice; reversing the old ZR tag and rebooking S1-EU in the VAT ledger is necessary.

Proposed journal:
- Debit AR (INV-2027-1184) EUR 46,200
- Credit AR (INV-2028-031) EUR 46,200
- Adjust VAT ledger: reverse previous VAT reversal entry for INV-2027-1184 (JNL-REF prev), post VAT forward entry under JNL-REF-2028-031.

I can prepare the JNL-REF-2028-031 file and the supporting schedule if you want me to draft it and share for approval.

— Karthik
Senior Accounting Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: Marcus Holt <mholt@octagon-resellers.com>, payments@octagon-resellers.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-03T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice / VAT code mismatch

Hi Marcus — thanks for confirming the payer reference (OCT-0274). We've completed the reallocation and the journal correction is queued. Details below:

What we did:
- Reapplied EUR 46,200 from INV-2027-1184 to INV-2028-031 in AR (system ref: APPLY-20280303-9821).
- Posted VAT correction JNL-REF-2028-031 to reverse the old reversal and apply standard VAT code S1-EU.

Attachments: remittance_20280228.csv (your file), journal_correction_20280302.xlsx (supporting entries and GL impact).

Action for you: please confirm receipt on your end and that your tax team is satisfied with the re-tagging. If you'd like, we can provide a signed adjustment memo for your records.

Thanks again for the quick turnaround. I'll leave this open for one business day for confirmation, then we'll close the ticket.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: remittance_20280228.csv (CSV), journal_correction_20280302.xlsx (xlsx)
